about: Test fixture: history files (errata E-68) of a test account (test secrets) on vault-core's simulated proxy, localnet deployment. Generated by generate.mjs from hops client-next a948a92.

warnings: this history file is not authenticated: anyone who knows the openings it lists can write one (a view-key holder too), and holding one proves no ownership. It shows that its maker knows these openings and that the chain holds these notes and spends up to the cut; its totals are not a proof of funds
the owner chose what this file lists: it proves what it lists, never that nothing is missing (a note, a generation or another device's notes can be left out)
the file shows the account up to block 1015 (header hash 90bd048d14e0cad4ce15c45ea6b682aa88530ff119b9745ee3f244f4c72715bf); nothing after the cut is read or shown
held notes are the file's statement: their nullifiers are left out, so the viewer cannot check that they were unspent at the cut

payees and exit addresses are the file's statement: a payee is the destination the owner's vault authorized (a redirect home or a veto may have sent the money elsewhere), and the chain's bulk feeds name no past payee
